page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Printed page number top left. Running head top centre. Small marginal marks ("»" and similar) stand at the left margin beside the lines from "bum, tefte Saraceno" to "elapfus". No other blocks.

main_text.p: primus Iulianus,& ab eo exclufiue retrorfum numerentur anni folares ducenti & fexaginta fex, hoc eft, exactæ enneadecaeterides quatuordecim, cum tribus menfibus Decembri, Nouembri & Octobri: tuc afcenditur ad æram Dhilkarnain, quæ incurrit in annum folarem habentem literam dominicalem G, & XIX pro aureo numero: in quem incidit Thoth Nabonalari quadringentefimus trigefimus feptimus, feria fexta, nono die Nouembris: vt prima Octobris anni prædicti folaris habenda fit pro æra Alexandri Dhilkarnain. Atqui in prima Octobris incurrit dies vigefima feptima Epiphi anni Nabonalari quadringentefimi trigefimi feptimi fexti: quamobrem concludimus ante æram Dhilkarnain elapfos effe annos Nabonafari quadringentos triginta quinque, cum diebus trecentis viginti fex, hoc eft, in vniuerfum 1 5 9101 dies.

Hi fi fubtrahantur ab annis Ægyptiis 1369, & 117 diebus, hoc eft, à diebus in vniuerfum 499802, qui fluxerunt à Nabonafaro vfque ad politicam æram Arabum, relinquuntur 340701 dies, quod eft interuallum inter æram Alexandri Dhilkarnain & Arabum, tefte Saraceno. Hinc apparet, qua methodo inuestigandi fint anni Alexandri: fi enim ad annos Iulianos adiiciantur anni 267, prouenit principium annorum Dhilkarnain, quod perpetuo incidit in primam Octobris: quare cum tres menfes, October fcilicet, Nouember & December, cum annis ducentis fexaginta fex, fint elapfi vfq; ad kalendas primas Iulianas, fi adiiciantur nouem primi menfes Iuliani, videlicet Ianuarius, Februarius, Martius, Aprilis, Maius, Iunius, Iulius, Augustus & September, completur annus ducentefimus feptuagefimus fexagefimus ab æra Dhilkarnain elapfus, vt anno primo Iuliano, kalendis Octobribus incipit »ineat.

page.notes: Left-margin marks ("»", possibly printer's signs or ditto marks) stand beside several lines and could not be identified; they are recorded here, not as text. Numerals in the Egyptian/Arabic reckoning passage (e.g. "1 5 9101", "340701", "499802") are doubtful and may contain printing errors; the sequence "ducentefimus feptuagefimus fexagefimus fexagefimus" is also doubtful. The word "Nabonalari" appears hyphenated across lines and is written here as printed. The last line "ineat" is a fragment completing the previous sentence.
